description: Connect a social account. For youtube/instagram/linkedin/threads/facebook/pinterest/fanvue: returns an authorization URL — the user must open it in a browser where they are signed in to Post Engineer with the same account, and authorize; the account then connects automatically (verify with list_social_accounts). A browser that is not signed in, or signed in as another user, is rejected. For bluesky: connects directly with handle + appPassword (app password, not the main account password). For 3speak: connects directly with Hive username + posting key (posting key, not the owner/active/master password) For rumble: connects directly with channelId + accessToken (40-character Simple Upload API token, issued by emailing bd@rumble.com — no OAuth).

accessToken.description: Rumble 40-character Simple Upload API access token (issued by emailing bd@rumble.com). Required only for rumble. Never shared or logged.

appPassword.description: Bluesky app password (Settings > App passwords). Required only for bluesky. Never shared or logged.

channelId.description: Rumble channel ID. Required only for rumble.

handle.description: Bluesky handle (e.g. user.bsky.social). Required only for bluesky.

postingKey.description: Hive posting key (the posting key only — never the owner, active, or master password). Required only for 3speak. Never shared or logged.

username.description: Hive username (e.g. alice). Required only for 3speak.

name: connect_account
